programs.title: Europe From Above 4
programs.desc: The creators of the series will present Scotland, Denmark, Serbia, Belgium, Bulgaria and Romania from a bird's eye view.They will use, among others, modern drones.Viewers will see the greatest cultural and geographical national treasures.They will see how tradition, engineering and nature have shaped these places.In the first episode they will go to Scotland.They will soar over the town of St Andrews and see how gardeners look after the famous golf course.In East Lothian they will see natural treasures, including honey bees feasting on heather flowers.They will then investigate an ambitious engineering project that harnesses the power of the ocean to generate electricity.A team of archaeologists will reconstruct a traditional Scottish house.

programs.title: Sardinien - Arche aus Stein
programs.desc: The Mediterranean Sea, as the only body of water in the world, has witnessed such intense, continuous and extensive climate changes, the merging of sea currents, the intertwining of ecosystems, nations, cultures, ideas and genes.About 40 million years ago, Sardinia broke away from the southern tip of Europe and began moving towards Africa.During its journey, the island, like a great rock ship, collected various passengers from land and sea.The creators of the documentary will talk about this second largest island in Italy, which is eagerly visited by holidaymakers.Its diverse coastline includes, among others, impressive cliffs and picturesque beaches.Viewers will see, among others, a colony of flamingos and the famous rock falcons.They will also visit donkeys from the island of Asinara, and wild boars, mouflons and griffon vultures in the forest.They will see the largest herd of wild horses in Europe and caves containing cave changelings and fossils of a species of giant deer that became extinct in Sardinia in the Stone Age.
